title: How to Check Land Ownership in Bangladesh Online: Complete Khatian, Mutation & Porcha Verification Guide 2026
metaTitle: How to Check Land Ownership in Bangladesh Online (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Step-by-step 2026 guide to checking land ownership in Bangladesh online. Verify CS/SA/RS/BS Khatian, e-Porcha, Mutation, and DCR before buying property.

heroIntro: With the full digitalization of land records under the Ministry of Land and the Directorate of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), verifying property ownership in Bangladesh no longer requires visiting tehsils blindly. Buyers, institutional investors, and Non-Resident Bangladeshis (NRBs) can now inspect historical Khatians, mutation orders, and land tax receipts from anywhere in the world. However, digital portals do not detect un-registered mortgages, forged title deeds, or undisclosed heirs. This comprehensive 2026 verification guide by Advocate Md. Shah Alam (Advocate, Supreme Court of Bangladesh) explains how to verify property records online and what offline checks remain indispensable.

quickAnswer.heading: ⚡ Quick Verification Breakdown: Online Land Records in Bangladesh
points: e-Porcha Portal (eporcha.gov.bd): Free digital search for CS, SA, RS, and BS Khatians; ৳100 government fee for certified copy delivery.
e-Mutation Portal (mutation.land.gov.bd): Verify ownership transfer status, AC Land order sheet, DCR (Duplicate Carbon Receipt), and QR-coded certificate.
Land Development Tax (ldtax.gov.bd): Inspect holding numbers and annual tax payments to confirm active lawful possession.
Sub-Registry Physical Search: Online databases do NOT confirm deed authenticity—always conduct a 12-to-30-year volume index search (Balaam Boi) at the local Sub-Registry Office.
Legal Title Vetting: For property purchases in Dhaka, Uttara, or anywhere in Bangladesh, consult Supreme Court Advocate Md. Shah Alam at +8801712655546.

sections.h2: Why Online Land Verification is Mandatory Before Any Property Purchase
sections.content:
Purchasing real estate in Bangladesh without rigorous due diligence carries substantial risk of fraud, double sales, and inheritance disputes. The Ministry of Land's digital infrastructure allows buyers to review records of rights instantly, preventing obvious impersonation and forged surveys.

However, digital records represent fiscal survey entries (presumption of possession) rather than indisputable evidence of legal title. A verified property must possess an unbroken chain of ownership connecting the oldest cadastral survey down to the present vendor.

sections.h2: Understanding the Survey Chain: CS, SA, RS, and BS/City Khatians
sections.content:
To establish clean title, your legal counsel will inspect each successive land survey conducted across Bangladesh:

  • CS (Cadastral Survey - 1888–1940): The baseline colonial survey establishing historical root title.
  • SA (State Acquisition Survey - 1956–1962): Created after the abolition of the zamindari system to record tenant-farmers.
  • RS (Revisional Survey - 1966–1990s): Updated survey rectifying SA discrepancies and reflecting partitioned plots.
  • BS / City Survey (Bangladesh Survey - 1998–Present): The latest survey in Dhaka, Chittagong, and major municipalities. Mutation must match the BS Khatian.

sections.h2: Step-by-Step: How to Search Khatian (Porcha) Online on eporcha.gov.bd
sections.content:
Follow these official steps to inspect or download records on eporcha.gov.bd:

  1. Navigate to the Survey Khatian (জরিপ খতিয়ান) module on the homepage.
  2. Select the Division (বিভাগ), District (জেলা), Upazila/Thana (উপজেলা), and exact Mouza with JL Number.
  3. Choose the survey type: CS, SA, RS, or BS.
  4. Enter the Khatian Number or Dag (Plot) Number, or search by the recorded owner’s name.
  5. View the online preview showing plot shares, boundaries, and recorded owners.
  6. For legal proceedings or registration, apply online for a certified certified copy (সার্টিফাইড কপি) by paying the statutory fee (৳100).

sections.h2: Checking Mutation (Namjari) & DCR Authenticity on mutation.land.gov.bd
sections.content:
Whenever land changes hands through purchase, gift (Heba), or inheritance, the buyer must mutate their name under Section 143 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950. To verify a mutation:

  • Log onto mutation.land.gov.bd and enter the Application ID or Khatian Number.
  • Inspect the AC Land Order Sheet to verify whether due process, newspaper notices, and hearing of all co-sharers occurred.
  • Confirm the Duplicate Carbon Receipt (DCR) showing payment of the ৳1,170 government mutation fee.
  • Scan the QR code on the computerized Mutation Certificate to ensure it matches the database of the Ministry of Land.

sections.h2: Verifying Land Development Tax (LD Tax / Khajna) Online
sections.content:
Since 2023, manual land tax collection in Bangladesh has ceased. All taxes must be cleared via ldtax.gov.bd.

Request the vendor’s Holding Number and NID-linked profile. The digital Dakhila (tax receipt) must reflect cleared arrears up to the current fiscal year (১৪৩২-১৪৩৩ বঙ্গাব্দ / 2026). Incomplete tax records obstruct smooth deed registration.

sections.h2: Critical Limitations: What Online Portals Cannot Reveal
sections.content:
Online government portals are administrative databases; they do NOT certify clean legal title. Major vulnerabilities that online portals miss include:

  • Unregistered Encumbrances: Equitable mortgages with financial institutions where original deeds are deposited without mutation alteration.
  • Pending Civil Suits: Lis pendens suits in Civil Courts for partition (বণ্টন), cancellation of deed (দলিল বাতিল), or pre-emption (অগ্রক্রয়).
  • Disinherited Heirs: Missing heirs under Muslim or Hindu succession laws whose shares were fraudulently omitted in vendor's mutation.
  • Physical Possession Deficits: Adverse possession or land-grabbing by local encroachers.

sections.h2: The Lawyer's Offline Title Search: Balaam Boi & Non-Encumbrance (NEC)
sections.content:
To eliminate purchase risks, a Supreme Court property lawyer performs manual offline vetting:

  1. Balaam Boi Search (বালাম বই তল্লাশি): Physical inspection of the volume record index at the concerned Sub-Registry Office to ensure the vendor's deed was genuine and not cancelled.
  2. Non-Encumbrance Certificate (NEC / ১২ ধারা তল্লাশি): Applying for an official 12-to-30-year search certificate certifying that the property has not been encumbered, mortgaged, or transferred to third parties.
  3. Chain of Title Report: Drafting a formal Title Vetting Opinion analyzing the legal coherence of all predecessor deeds.

sections.h2: Document Checklist Before Paying Earnest Money (Baina)
sections.content:
Ensure you have certified copies of the following documents in hand before signing any Baina Agreement:

  • Original Title Deed (মূল দলিল) and all Bia Deeds (বায়া দলিল) for 25–30 years.
  • Certified CS, SA, RS, and City/BS Survey Khatians.
  • Registered Mutation Khatian, AC Land Order Sheet, and DCR.
  • Up-to-date online Land Development Tax (Khajna) Dakhila.
  • Sub-Registry 12-year Non-Encumbrance Search Receipt.
  • Approved building plan and clearance letters (for residential plots/apartments).

faqs.question: Can an online Khatian prove 100% legal ownership?
faqs.answer: No. A Khatian creates a legal presumption of possession, but true ownership depends on valid registered deeds, unbroken title chain, and actual peaceful physical possession.

faqs.question: How much does a certified copy of Khatian cost online?
faqs.answer: The government fee is ৳100 for an online certified copy delivered via post or downloadable directly from eporcha.gov.bd.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Khatian and Mutation?
faqs.answer: A Khatian is an official survey record prepared periodically by the government. Mutation (Namjari) is the intermediate process by which a new owner's name replaces the seller's name in official records after purchase or inheritance.

faqs.question: Why is a 12-year Non-Encumbrance Certificate (NEC) necessary?
faqs.answer: An NEC issued by the Sub-Registrar proves that no other registered deeds, mortgages, or transfers have occurred on the specified property within the searched duration.
